core_obligations: Reduce to the affine case (proof lines 6031-6040): the assertion is local on the base and on the test scheme, so the author assumes everything affine, where the base change of an integral morphism is described by a ring-theoretic situation.

Produce the covering (proof lines 6040-6053): the author constructs the required etale covering of the base and verifies that over each member the base change decomposes as a disjoint union with the morphisms factoring through the given covering, which is exactly property (B).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the affine case using locality and integrality.
Construct the required etale covering and the disjoint union decomposition.
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies property (B) for an integral morphism of schemes (statement lines 6025-6029, with property (B) delivered verbatim as a context span from lines 5708-5726). The proof reduces to the affine case using locality of the assertion and integrality of the morphism (proof lines 6031-6040) and then constructs the required etale covering of the base with the associated disjoint union decompositions (proof lines 6040-6053). The non-formal content is the affine construction, in which integrality replaces finiteness. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one construction.
